items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 185:1
items.html: It has already been explained that there are internal NRN and external Nefesh and Ruach. And these, of the internal NRN, are considered the aspect of the Neshama of BYA, and from them are born the NRN of the righteous, which are the aspect of Divinity. And of the external Nefesh and Ruach it is said, "from there it was parted", for everything born of them is the aspect of the externality of BYA, which are separated and are not Divinity, that is, the angels, the firmaments, and the palaces, etc.
